title: Syrian Hacker Gets Prison Time in US After Over a Decade on the Run
description: Ahmad Umar Agha, a Syrian hacker affiliated with the Syrian Electronic Army, was sentenced to 42 months in a US federal court for a hacking conspiracy directed by Syrian intelligence figures. Over more than a decade, he compromised around 47 targets including Western media, companies, NGOs, and government entities, causing significant disruption and financial losses. Notable incidents include the 2013 hijacking of the Associated Press Twitter account that triggered a stock market flash crash and attacks on the Marine Corps recruiting website and White House social media accounts.
